name: Opal
tagline: Play everything — the evolved media player
description: One media player for everything — files, sites, servers, and feeds. Say a title, a file, a magnet, or a vibe, and Opal finds and plays it a moment later. AI-powered discovery built for speed in Zig, running on macOS, Linux, and Windows.
audience: People who want one fast, native place to find and play media instead of a browser full of services, players, feeds, and tabs.
positioning: The Next Decades of Entertainment Should Belong to Whoever Is Holding the Remote.

features.title: Ask for Media Naturally
features.description: Start with a title, local file, magnet link, server, feed, or a mood. Opal turns the request into something playable.

features.title: Keep One Clean Surface
features.description: Search, discovery, chat, browsing, and playback share one window instead of handing the journey across disconnected apps.

features.title: Stay Native and Extensible
features.description: A Zig core keeps startup and runtime lean while source plugins let endpoints evolve without turning the player into a monolith.
